decisions.D1_audit_validated_not_notvalid: Probe B shows zero audit rows, so the validation scan is free and there is no deferral to justify. The constraint is trustworthy from the first row Production writes.
decisions.D2_no_audit_trigger: Every Day-1 audit writer INSERTs; none UPDATEs. An updated_at trigger is not exercised by any Day-1 path, so it is NOT REQUIRED and not installed.
decisions.D3_legacy_columns_preserved: The four legacy columns are kept. Only a NOT-NULL-without-default is relaxed, because the app never writes them and 23502 would otherwise abort every audited Day-1 mutation.
decisions.D4_no_policies: No Day-1 read or write uses the anon or authenticated role — verified module by module at HEAD 24556ad. RLS with no policy and no grant is the narrowest safe remediation. Any future authenticated read path must ship its own policy AND grant.
decisions.D5_execution_gated_by_probe_c: Which credential the deployment presents is not knowable from the database, so T3 installs the lifecycle functions ungranted and T4 grants EXECUTE only after Probe C proves the deployed key resolves to service_role.
decisions.D6_scope_decision_A: admin_scope_access holds season/program CODES while the lifecycle scope branch compares UUIDs, so no scope row could authorize S12. The controlled super_admin operator is used and no row is seeded.
decisions.D7_vam062_omitted: Installing VAM062 V3 to reach the admin console would multiply the release surface for a non-Day-1 path. Accepted as P1-2 with a documented workaround.
